_comment: Dev-bench instance config — copy to <repo-root>/.playbook-jupi/config.local.json (gitignored) and fill the <angle-bracket> placeholders. Never commit the filled copy: it holds the Neon string and the dev mailbox address. Keys starting with '_' are documentation; nothing reads them.
_jupiWorkspace: the Jupi workspace bench decisions go to — the shared test workspace, NEVER a real one (probe: search-decisions-tool with this slug returns {"items":[...]}; 'Group not found' means a typo)
_jupiUserId: the tenant key stamped on every Neon row — the row-level isolation. The bench uses a synthetic id on the SHARED project; dev/seed.mjs and dev/reset.mjs refuse to run under any tenant not prefixed 'dev-' or 'eval-'
_neonConnString: project-scoped Neon connection string (same project as the internal install — the tenant key separates rows, nothing new to provision). Ask the project owner; lives only in this local file or $NEON_CONN_STRING
_watchedSource: the inbound source the watch reads — a generic engine-facing key (the inbound-watch rewrite owns its final shape); THIS bench's instance is a mailbox: the fake operator's dev Gmail (see dev/mirror/README.md, 'Léa Marchal'). The real address is deliberately NOT in the repo: fill it here locally
_dossierSource: where the tracked dossiers are read from — a generic engine-facing key (the bootstrap will read it); THIS bench's instance is the pilot mirror's fake reporting sheet
_projectionTarget: where the human-readable playbook projection lands on the bench — a local file standing in for the real store (hybrid tier 1: Sheet/Notion as local files)
